```sql
WITH geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Ontelaunee Township'
    AND border_type = 'township'
    AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geom FROM (VALUES (ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((...)))) AS wkt_geom) AS sub))
),
clipped_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM geom), TRUE) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM geom))
)
SELECT ST_ValueCount(rast, 1).sum / ST_Area(ST_Union(ST_Envelope(rast))) * 10000 AS avg_elevation_meters
FROM clipped_rast;
```
